summary: This tumor shows the same M2 + metabolic vulnerability as Tier 1A, but with a stronger stromal exclusion signal (CAF/TGF-β/CXCL12 axis). In this setting, checkpoint therapy alone is unlikely to penetrate without a stromal unlock step.

sequence: Add stromal unlock (e.g., anti-fibrotic / CXCR4/TGF-β axis disruption; see stromal arm score).
Introduce checkpoint inhibitor after stromal barrier reduces.
recommendation.rationale: Stromal exclusion must be reduced before immune activation can access tumor.

evidence_citations: PMC9899624 (AMPK activation and platinum sensitivity mechanism; referenced for hypothesis generation).
notes: RUO: research-only brief. Requires clinical validation; not medical advice.
